# PAYSTREAM TECHNOLOGIES, INC. SERVICES AGREEMENT

**Effective March 1, 2026**

Published at: https://www.paystream.com/legal/services-agreement

---

## GENERAL TERMS

**Last Modified: September 28, 2026**

### 1. Services

**1.1 Availability and Use**

Paystream Technologies, Inc. and its Affiliates will make the Services available to User and, if applicable, provide access to a Paystream Dashboard. Paystream may activate certain Services or functionality for User's account, which User may deactivate by contacting Paystream or, where available, through the Paystream Dashboard or API. User shall use the Services only for User's Business Purposes and in accordance with applicable Documentation.

**1.2 Restrictions**

(a) **General Restrictions.** User shall not, and shall not permit or enable any third party to:

(i) use the Services for personal, family, or household consumption;

(ii) bypass technical protections or restrictions of the Services, or attempt to access non-public Paystream systems or data;

(iii) use the Services for fraudulent, deceptive, exploitative, or harmful conduct;

(iv) take any action that interferes with the Services' operation or impairs other Paystream users' access to the Services;

(v) lease, rent, or transfer User's account rights or Services to any third party;

(vi) copy, republish, upload, transmit, resell, or distribute any component of the Services, Documentation, or Paystream Website except as permitted by law;

(vii) create a Paystream Account for or on behalf of any user whose account has been suspended or terminated by Paystream, unless Paystream provides written approval;

(viii) operate as a service bureau or pass-through intermediary providing the Services without adding meaningful value to Users; or

(ix) use the Services for Prohibited or Restricted Business activities, or enable any person or entity (including User) to participate in or benefit from any Prohibited or Restricted Business, unless Paystream has provided written pre-approval for such business.

(b) **Age Restrictions.** Only individuals age 13 or older may open a Paystream Account and use the Services and Paystream Technology. If User or User's Representative is under age 18 (or the applicable age of majority):

(i) User shall add an adult Representative (which may include a parent or legal guardian) to the Account;

(ii) both User and Representative agree to be bound by this Agreement; and

(iii) Representative shall assume responsibility for and liability arising from User's actions on the Account and User's compliance with this Agreement.

**1.3 Support Services**

Paystream shall provide standard technical support for Account-related issues and Service use through support channels and Documentation available on the Paystream Website. Paystream also offers optional paid support plans providing priority access and enhanced response times beyond standard support. Paystream shall have no obligation to provide support to Customers.

**1.4 Preview Services**

Paystream may make Preview Services available to User. Paystream shall indicate via the Paystream Dashboard, Website, or other means whether a Service or feature is a Preview Service. Paystream may specify additional requirements or restrictions for Preview Service use in Preview Service Terms or Documentation. Unless otherwise agreed in writing by Paystream, User's Preview Service use is confidential and User shall provide timely Feedback upon Paystream's request. Paystream may modify, add, remove, or suspend Preview Services at any time. Preview Services may be incomplete, unstable, or contain errors, and use is at User's sole risk. User shall not deploy Preview Services in production environments unless User understands and accepts the associated limitations. Paystream may communicate Preview Service Fees outside the Paystream Pricing Page. To the maximum extent permitted by law, Paystream provides no warranty, indemnity, or support for Preview Services. Paystream's total liability for Preview Services shall not exceed the lesser of (i) total Fees paid by User to Paystream (excluding all pass-through fees from Financial Providers) during the 12-month period prior to the event giving rise to liability, or (ii) USD $1,000.

**1.5 Service Modifications and Updates**

(a) **Modifications.** Paystream may modify, suspend, or discontinue any aspect of the Services or Paystream Technology, including imposing conditions on use or ceasing to offer a Service in specific countries or regions. Paystream shall provide User with reasonable notice if a modification or discontinuation materially reduces a Service's or Paystream Technology's functionality that User is actively using, except where Paystream determines that notice would (i) create or increase a security risk for Paystream, its users, or Financial Providers; or (ii) require Paystream or its Affiliates to violate law or breach obligations to any Governmental Authority or Financial Provider.

(b) **Updates.** Paystream has no obligation to provide Updates but may do so at its discretion. When Updates are made available, User shall implement them by the deadline stated in Paystream's notice. If no deadline is specified, User shall implement the Update within 30 days of the notice date.

**1.6 Third-Party Services**

Paystream may reference, permit access to, or promote Third-Party Services. User's use of any Third-Party Service is governed by that service provider's terms and privacy policies and undertaken at User's sole risk. Paystream does not approve, endorse, recommend, or assume responsibility or liability for any Third-Party Services.

**1.7 AI Agents**

If User employs an AI Agent to access the Services, User shall be solely responsible for all actions initiated by or through such AI Agent. User acknowledges that: (a) an AI Agent constitutes an "electronic agent" as defined or recognized under the Uniform Electronic Transactions Act or similar applicable law; and (b) actions initiated or completed by an AI Agent are binding on User.

### 2. License to Paystream Technology

**2.1 Grant of License**

Subject to this Agreement, Paystream and its Affiliates grant User a limited, worldwide, royalty-free, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except as permitted in Section 11.10), non-sublicensable, revocable license during the Term to use Paystream Technology solely (i) as necessary to use the Services, (ii) for User's Business Purposes, and (iii) in compliance with law, this Agreement, and applicable Documentation. Paystream Technology is licensed, not sold, to User. All Updates, upgrades, new versions, and replacements shall be governed by this Agreement unless accompanied by a separate license, in which case that license shall control.

**2.2 License Restrictions**

User shall not use or operate Paystream Technology except in accordance with this Agreement and Documentation. User may distribute elements of Paystream Technology designated by Paystream as "distributable" only in binary or object code form and subject to an end user license agreement at least as protective of Paystream and its licensors as this Section. User shall not use Paystream Technology in any manner that would obligate User to (i) disclose or distribute Paystream Technology in source code form; (ii) license Paystream Technology for creating modifications or derivative works; or (iii) redistribute Paystream Technology without charge. User shall not remove, obscure, modify, or tamper with any notices including trademark, copyright, or proprietary notices contained in Paystream Technology.

**2.3 Third-Party Software**

In case of conflict between open source license terms and this Agreement regarding open source code, the open source license terms shall prevail with respect to that code. Except as required by law, User shall not (and shall not enable any third party to) decompile, reverse engineer, disassemble, attempt to derive source code from, decrypt, modify, translate, or create derivative works of Paystream Technology or any Paystream services. User shall not remove, obscure, or alter any proprietary notices including trademark and copyright notices in Paystream Technology.

**2.5 Restrictions on Transfer**

User shall not rent, lease, lend, sell, share, redistribute, or sublicense Paystream Technology or enable others to do so, unless expressly permitted by this Agreement or authorized in writing by Paystream.

### 3. Account Security

Paystream is entitled to rely on any instruction or action taken within User's Account. User shall ensure that its Account is not accessed or modified by any unauthorized party and shall use commercially reasonable efforts to prevent unauthorized access, disclosure, or use of Account Credentials. If User believes Account Credentials have been wrongly accessed, disclosed, or used, User shall promptly notify Paystream and provide full cooperation, including all information Paystream reasonably requests. Paystream's actions or inactions shall not diminish User's responsibility for Account Credential security or any unauthorized access or use thereof. User shall be solely responsible for all losses, damages, or costs arising from hacking, tampering, unauthorized access to the Services, Account, or Protected Data, or User's failure to implement anti-fraud or data security measures, except to the extent such losses, damages, or costs result directly from Paystream's gross negligence, fraud, or willful misconduct.

### 4. Privacy and Data Use

**4.1 Data Processing**

Each party shall comply with the Data Processing Agreement, including the Data Transfers Addendum, which is incorporated herein by this reference. The Data Processing Agreement sets forth each party's obligations regarding Personal Data processing in connection with the Services.

**4.2 Permitted Use of Paystream Data**

User shall use Paystream Data only as expressly permitted by this Agreement or other written agreements between Paystream and User or their Affiliates.

**4.3 Data Incident Notification**

If User experiences a Data Incident reasonably likely to impact Paystream or its Affiliates, User shall notify Paystream without unreasonable delay, but no later than 48 hours after discovering the incident. Such notice shall include: (a) the type of Personal Data affected; (b) the categories and estimated number of individuals or records affected, including their countries; and (c) the status of User's investigation and planned remediation efforts.

**4.4 Data Retention**

Paystream shall have no obligation to retain data received from or through User following Term expiration, except as (a) required by law; (b) reasonably necessary for Paystream to fulfill post-termination obligations; (c) otherwise provided in this Agreement; or (d) the parties agree in writing.

**4.5 Third-Party Data**

If User enables Services or functionality granting Paystream access to data, including Personal Data and Content, from User's third-party service providers ("Third-Party Data"), User authorizes Paystream to access and use such Third-Party Data. User shall obtain all necessary rights and consents from applicable individuals and third parties to enable Paystream to lawfully collect, use, retain, and disclose Third-Party Data. Paystream shall use Third-Party Data as described in this Agreement and to (a) provide and maintain Paystream services; (b) comply with law and Financial Provider requirements; and (c) prevent and mitigate fraud and financial loss. User shall not provide Protected Health Information as Third-Party Data. User shall be liable for any Protected Health Information disclosure to Paystream.

**4.6 Safeguards**

Each party shall maintain commercially reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards protecting data in its possession or control from unauthorized access, accidental loss, and unauthorized modification. Paystream shall comply with its obligations in the Data Security Exhibit.

**4.7 Use of Paystream Output Data**

User's use of Paystream Output Data is limited to User's internal business purposes and the intended purpose described in applicable Service Terms or Documentation. User shall not use Paystream Output Data: (a) as the sole basis for User's decision-making process regarding business relationships with Customers or automated decision-making or profiling; (b) as a factor in determining eligibility for credit, insurance, housing, or employment, or in any manner causing Paystream to be a "consumer reporting agency" (as defined in the Fair Credit Reporting Act) or Paystream Output Data to constitute a "consumer report" under the Fair Credit Reporting Act or comparable law; (c) to discriminate based on protected characteristics or take "adverse action" (as defined in the Fair Credit Reporting Act); (d) in a manner constituting a prohibited AI practice under the EU AI Act or causing Paystream to be characterized as a provider or co-deployer of a high-risk AI system; or (e) to develop, test, train, enhance, or deploy machine learning models substantially similar to or substituting for the Services. User shall not sell, rent, transfer, make available, or disclose Paystream Output Data orally or through other means. User shall delete Paystream Output Data promptly upon Paystream's reasonable written request.

### 5. Intellectual Property

**5.1 Ownership and Rights**

(a) **IP Rights.** As between the parties, Paystream, its Affiliates, and their third-party licensors own all intellectual property rights in the Services, Paystream Technology, Paystream Data, Paystream Marks, Documentation, and Paystream Website. All rights not expressly granted are reserved.

(b) **Reservation of Rights.** This Agreement does not assign, transfer, or contemplate the sharing of any intellectual property ownership or joint development of intellectual property.

(c) **User Representations and License.** User shall ensure that its use of the Services and Paystream Technology does not violate or infringe any third-party rights, including intellectual property rights. If User provides Content to Paystream, User represents that it has obtained all necessary rights and permissions to share the Content. User grants Paystream and its Affiliates a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use the Content to develop, improve, and provide Services and Paystream Technology and for Paystream's internal business purposes.

**5.2 Feedback**

User may provide Feedback to Paystream and its Affiliates during the Term, which Paystream may use without restriction or compensation obligation. Feedback is voluntary, and User grants Paystream and its Affiliates a perpetual, worldwide, non-exclusive, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use Feedback for any purpose.

**5.3 Marks Usage**

(a) **License Grant.** Subject to this Agreement, each party (or its applicable Affiliates) grants the other a worldwide, non-exclusive, non-transferable (except as permitted in Section 11.10), non-sublicensable (except to its Affiliates and applicable Financial Providers), royalty-free license during the Term to use the granting party's Marks solely to provide the Services to User and to identify Paystream as User's service provider. All goodwill generated from Marks usage shall inure to the sole benefit of the Mark owner.

(b) **Paystream's Permitted Uses of User's Marks.** Paystream and its Affiliates may reference User as a Services user in their financial disclosure documents. Paystream and its Affiliates may use User's Marks (i) on Paystream webpages and applications identifying Paystream's customers or users; (ii) in Paystream sales, marketing materials, and communications; and (iii) in connection with any promotional activities to which the parties agree in writing. Paystream shall comply with any usage terms or guidelines User provides in writing.

(c) **User's Permitted Uses of Paystream Marks.** User shall comply with the terms located at https://paystream.com/legal/marks/ and all additional usage terms and guidelines Paystream provides in writing.

### 6. Confidentiality

**6.1 Protection of Confidential Information**

Each party (as "Recipient") shall use reasonable care, and no less care than it uses to protect its own similar confidential information, to prevent unauthorized disclosure of the other party's (the "Discloser") Confidential Information.

**6.2 Permitted Disclosures**

A Recipient may disclose Confidential Information only to its and its Affiliates' directors, employees, contractors, agents, professional advisors, and third-party auditors having a legitimate need to know, all subject to confidentiality obligations at least as protective as this Agreement. Paystream may also disclose User's Confidential Information to Financial Providers, their Affiliates, and Paystream's third-party service providers as reasonably necessary to perform the Services.

**6.3 Legally Required Disclosures**

A Recipient may disclose Confidential Information if required by law, subpoena, court order, or Governmental Authority directive. Subject to Data Processing Agreement obligations, Recipient shall use reasonable efforts to provide Discloser advance notice of required disclosure (if law permits). Recipient shall provide assistance at Discloser's expense to contest the disclosure if Discloser requests.

**6.4 Confidentiality Exclusions**

Confidentiality obligations do not apply to information that: (a) becomes publicly available through no Recipient fault; (b) was known or possessed without restriction prior to receipt from Discloser; (c) was received from a third party without confidentiality breach; or (d) was independently developed without using Discloser's Confidential Information.

### 7. Fees, Taxes, and Bank Accounts

**7.1 Service Fees**

(a) **Fees.** Fees are as listed on the Paystream Pricing Page unless User and Paystream otherwise agree in writing, including via click-through agreement. Unless otherwise agreed in writing or required by law, payment obligations are non-cancelable and Fees paid are non-refundable.

(b) **Subscription Services.** Subscription Services are governed by the applicable Subscription Plan terms. If User exceeds Subscription Plan entitlements, Paystream shall charge User for the increased scope of use according to Paystream Pricing Page Fees unless the Subscription Plan or written agreement states otherwise.

(c) **Fee and Subscription Plan Changes.** Subject to law requirements, Paystream may revise Fees and Subscription Plans at any time. Paystream shall provide User with at least 30 days' notice of any Fee increase, new Fees for any Service User is using, or any materially adverse Subscription Plan change.

(d) **Fee Waivers.** Paystream may offer Services without charge or waive Fees and may begin charging upon at least 30 days' notice (or longer if law requires). Taxes may still be collected on waived Fees.

(e) **Trial and Promotional Offerings.** Paystream may offer Services on a trial or promotional basis free of charge or at a discount until (i) the trial or promotion expires, at which point Paystream Pricing Page Fees apply, or (ii) User's purchased Subscription Plan commences, at which point that plan begins automatically. Trials and promotions may be subject to additional Taxes, terms, and conditions as communicated by Paystream.

(f) **Fee Credits.** If User receives a Fee Credit, the Paystream Fee Credit Terms shall apply.

**7.2 Fee Collection and Payment**

(a) User shall pay, or ensure Paystream can collect, Fees, Taxes, and other amounts owed to Paystream under this Agreement or other Paystream agreements when due.

(b) Paystream may collect amounts owed by deducting them from User's Account balance, charging User's primary Payment Method (such as a credit card), or invoicing User.

(c) If Paystream cannot collect amounts due or if a User Entity's Account balance is negative or insufficient, Paystream or its Affiliate may, to the extent law permits, deduct, recoup, or set off these amounts from: (i) any applicable Reserve maintained for User; (ii) funds payable by Paystream to User; (iii) User's Account balance; (iv) each User Bank Account (if any); or (v) a backup User-selected Payment Method.

(d) If currencies differ between the amount being deducted and the amount owed, Paystream may deduct an amount equal to the debt owed using Paystream's conversion rate, plus Paystream's conversion fees.

(e) If Paystream believes it transferred funds to User in error, Paystream may deduct, recoup, or set off those funds in accordance with this Agreement.

**7.3 Taxes**

(a) **Tax Exclusion.** Fees exclude all Taxes unless the Paystream Pricing Page or other documents expressly state otherwise.

(b) **User's Tax Responsibilities.** User has sole responsibility and liability for: (i) determining which, if any, Taxes or fees apply to its product and service sales, donation acceptance, or payments received in connection with Service use; and (ii) assessing, collecting, reporting, and remitting Taxes to appropriate tax authorities.

(c) **Tax Collection and Withholding.** 

(i) If Paystream must collect or withhold Taxes by law, Paystream may deduct those Taxes from amounts otherwise owed to User or charge those Taxes and remit them to the appropriate taxing authority. If User is tax-exempt or eligible for a reduced rate, User may provide a copy of the original certificate satisfying legal requirements attesting to tax-exempt or reduced-rate status, in which case Paystream shall not deduct Taxes that certificate covers.

(ii) User shall provide accurate tax information as Paystream reasonably requests and shall promptly notify Paystream if any Paystream-prepopulated information is inaccurate or incomplete. Paystream may send documents to User and Governmental Authorities regarding transactions processed using the Services. Paystream may be required by law to file periodic informational returns with Governmental Authorities related to User's Service use. User consents to Paystream sending tax-related information electronically.

**7.4 Bank Account Requirements**

If Paystream requires User to link a Bank Account with Paystream in connection with Service use:

(a) User shall: (i) designate at least one Bank Account; (ii) be the named account holder of each Bank Account; (iii) maintain each Bank Account in a Paystream-approved country; and (iv) maintain authorization to initiate settlements to and debits from each Bank Account as provided in Section 7.5.

(b) User shall not grant or assign any lien on or interest in funds owed to User related to this Agreement to any third party until funds are deposited into a Bank Account.

**7.5 Debit Authorization**

Without limiting Section 7.2, User authorizes Paystream to debit and credit each Bank Account without separate notice according to the applicable Bank Account Debit Authorization to collect amounts User or another User Entity owes. If Paystream cannot collect amounts by debiting a Bank Account, User immediately grants Paystream a new authorization to debit each Bank Account without notice according to the applicable authorization. Paystream may rely on this authorization to attempt collection one or more times. This authorization shall remain in full force until (i) all User Entity Paystream Accounts are closed, or (ii) all Fees and other amounts owed are paid, whichever occurs later. If applicable debit scheme rules grant User the right to revoke authorization, User waives that right to the extent law permits.

### 8. Limitation of Liability

**8.1 Scope and Survival**

The exclusions and limitations in this Section 8 apply regardless of legal theory or cause of action and shall survive and apply even if any limited remedy fails of its essential purpose.

**8.2 Warranties Disclaimer**

Paystream provides the Services and Paystream Technology "as is." To the maximum extent permitted by law, Paystream makes no warranties and disclaims all warranties, statutory guarantees, implied warranties of fitness for a particular purpose, merchantability and non-infringement, and warranties arising from any course of dealing, course of performance, or usage in trade. Paystream does not warrant that Service or Paystream Technology use will be uninterrupted or error-free or that such use complies with law. Paystream is not liable for delays, failures, or problems inherent in internet and electronic communications use or other systems outside Paystream's control.

**8.3 Exclusion of Indirect Damages**

Except for Excluded Claims, to the maximum extent permitted by law, neither party shall have liability for any indirect, consequential, special, reliance, incidental, or punitive damages, lost revenue, profits, savings or goodwill, business interruption, personal injury, property damage, or data loss, whether in contract, negligence, strict liability, tort, or other legal or equitable theory, even if these losses, damages, or costs are foreseeable or either party has been advised of their possibility.

**8.4 Liability Cap**

Except for Excluded Claims, each party's total aggregate liability for damages and Losses arising from this Agreement shall not exceed the total Fees paid by User (excluding all pass-through fees from Financial Providers) during the 12-month period before the first event giving rise to liability. User's payment obligations, including Fees, Assessed Fines, and Taxes, are not limited by this Section 8.4.

### 9. Indemnification

**9.1 Indemnity Obligations**

(a) **General Indemnities.** Subject to Section 9.2, User shall indemnify Paystream, its Affiliates, and their directors, employees, and agents for all Losses arising from User's Service or Paystream Technology use, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, or material Agreement breach.

(b) **Intellectual Property Indemnities.**

(i) **Indemnity.** Subject to Section 9.2, each party shall indemnify the other, its Affiliates, and their directors, employees, and agents for all Losses arising from an Intellectual Property Claim, except that this obligation does not apply if the indemnified party uses the Materials in combination with other materials not provided by the indemnifying party (if the Materials alone would not infringe).

(ii) **Remedies.** If an Intellectual Property Claim arises, the indemnifying party may, at its sole discretion and expense, either (i) modify the Materials to be non-infringing, replace them with non-infringing alternatives, or obtain a license for the indemnified party to continue using them, or (ii) upon 30 days' notice, terminate the indemnified party's use of the infringing Materials.

(iii) **Exclusive Remedy.** This Section 9.1(b) states the indemnifying party's entire liability and the indemnified parties' sole and exclusive remedies regarding an Intellectual Property Claim.

**9.2 Indemnity Limitations**

An indemnifying party's Section 9.1 obligations shall not apply to the extent the Claim or Losses arise from the indemnified party's negligence, fraud, willful misconduct, or Agreement breach.

**9.3 Claim Defense**

If the indemnified party seeks to enforce an indemnity, it shall promptly notify the indemnifying party of the Claim and allow the indemnifying party to take exclusive control of defense and settlement. The indemnified party shall cooperate and provide reasonable assistance to the indemnifying party at the indemnifying party's expense without taking actions prejudicing the defense. The indemnifying party shall control defense (including counsel choice) and settlement at its expense but shall not settle imposing obligations on the indemnified party (except monetary payment, which the indemnifying party shall pay) without the indemnified party's prior written consent. The indemnified party's delay or failure to notify the indemnifying party shall not relieve the indemnifying party's indemnity obligations except to the extent prejudiced by such delay or failure.

### 10. Suspension and Termination

**10.1 Suspension and Termination Rights**

(a) **User Termination.**

(i) **Termination for Convenience.** User may terminate this Agreement at any time by closing its Account via the Paystream Dashboard.

(ii) **Termination for Cause.** User may immediately terminate this Agreement upon notice to Paystream if Paystream materially breaches this Agreement and does not cure within 10 days after receiving notice specifying the breach, if the breach is capable of cure.

(b) **Paystream Suspension and Termination.**

(i) **Suspension.** Paystream may immediately suspend User's access to Paystream Technology and any or all Services if:

(1) Paystream reasonably believes providing the Services to User violates or is reasonably likely to violate any law or Governmental Authority requirement, directive, or applicable Financial Provider Terms or directive;

(2) User experiences an Insolvency Event;

(3) User breaches this Agreement or any other agreement between the parties;

(4) Paystream reasonably believes User's actions or omissions degrade or may degrade the security, privacy, stability, or reliability of the Services, Paystream Technology, or any third party's system (including involvement in distributed denial of service attacks);

(5) Paystream reasonably believes User is engaged in unlawful business or activity that enables, facilitates, or may enable or facilitate illegal or prohibited transactions, may harm a third party, or presents unacceptable risk to Paystream;

(6) Paystream reasonably believes User's activity increases or may increase the fraud rate Paystream observes;

(7) User does not promptly respond to or fails to provide Paystream's User Information request; or

(8) User does not promptly update its Services or Paystream Technology implementation to the latest production version Paystream recommends or requires.

(ii) **Termination.**

(1) **Termination for Convenience.** Unless otherwise agreed in writing, Paystream may terminate this Agreement or close User's Account at any time. Paystream shall notify User in accordance with law.

(2) **Termination for Cause.** Paystream may immediately terminate this Agreement or revoke access to any Service or Paystream Technology if (A) User materially breaches this Agreement and, if capable of cure, does not cure within 10 days after receiving notice specifying the breach; (B) User experiences an Insolvency Event and law permits termination; (C) any Section 10.1(b)(i) event occurs; or (D) law requires or a Governmental Authority or Financial Provider directs termination. Paystream shall notify User in accordance with law.

**10.2 Termination Effect**

Upon termination, User's Service and Paystream Technology rights immediately cease. User shall immediately stop accessing the Services and delete all license keys, access keys, and Paystream Technology copies. Termination shall not relieve User's obligation to pay amounts owed for the period prior to termination's effective date. Termination shall not affect any other agreement between the parties or their Affiliates unless expressly stated.

**10.3 Survival**

The following shall survive termination:

(a) User's obligation to pay Fees;

(b) Sections 3 (Account Security), 5.1 (Ownership; Intellectual Property Rights), 5.2 (Feedback), 7 (Fees, Taxes, and Bank Accounts) to the extent applicable to Services provided or Transactions submitted during the Term, 8 (Limitation of Liability), 9 (Indemnification), 10.2 (Termination Effect), 11.2 (Notices and Communications), 11.3 (Governing Law), 11.4 (Dispute Resolution; Agreement to Arbitrate), 11.7 (Entire Agreement), 11.8 (Modification), 11.9 (Order of Precedence), 11.10 (Assignment), 11.11 (Severability), 11.12 (Waivers), 11.13 (Force Majeure), 11.14 (No Agency), 11.15 (Cumulative Rights; Injunctions), 11.17 (Interpretation), 12 (Definitions) to the extent used in a surviving clause, and 13 (Regional Terms);

(c) Section 4 (Privacy and Data Use) for so long as Paystream or User holds Paystream Data or Personal Data, as applicable;

(d) The Data Processing Agreement for so long as Paystream holds Personal Data or Protected Data, except Data Incident provisions where User is the data custodian, which shall survive for so long as User holds Paystream Data or Personal Data; and

(e) Trade secrets indefinitely, and all other confidentiality obligations for three years after the termination date.

### 11. General Provisions

**11.1 Legal Compliance**

Each party shall comply with all laws applicable to its business in performing this Agreement's obligations or exercising its rights. User is solely responsible for evaluating and configuring the Services to comply with User's legal obligations.

**11.2 Notices and Communications**

**Notices to Paystream.** Except as law may require or this Agreement states otherwise, for notices to Paystream, User shall contact Paystream. A notice Paystream receives from User is deemed received when Paystream receives it.

**Communications to User.** User consents to electronic communications as described in the E-SIGN Disclosure, incorporated herein by this reference. Paystream may also send User Communications by physical mail or delivery service to the postal address on the applicable Account. A Communication Paystream sends to User is deemed received on the earliest of (i) posting to the Paystream Website or Paystream Dashboard; (ii) text message or email transmission; or (iii) three business days after physical mail transmission or delivery service delivery.

**11.3 Governing Law**

This Agreement and all User-Paystream disputes shall be governed by, and construed in accordance with, the Governing Law as specified in Regional Terms, without regard to its conflict of law principles.

**11.4 Dispute Resolution and Arbitration**

(a) **Binding Arbitration.**

(i) **Claims Subject to Arbitration.** Except as stated in Section 11.4(a)(ii) or Regional Terms, all disputes, claims, and controversies, whether based on past, present, or future events, including those arising from or relating to statutory or common law and this Agreement's breach, termination, enforcement, interpretation, or validity, shall be resolved by binding arbitration by a single arbitrator.

(ii) **Claims Not Subject to Arbitration.** All disputes, claims, and controversies principally related to a party's Intellectual Property Rights shall be resolved by litigation. The parties submit to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts specified in Regional Terms for these disputes, claims, and controversies.

(iii) **Non-Waiver of Arbitration.** Making claims with law enforcement or governmental agencies, exercising self-help remedies (such as setoff rights), or seeking injunctive relief or provisional remedies from a court of appropriate jurisdiction does not constitute a waiver of any right to compel arbitration.

(iv) **Procedural Matters.** Arbitration shall be conducted in English. Regional Terms shall specify the arbitration seat and applicable arbitration rules and procedure.

(v) **Award Provision.** Subject to this Agreement's liability limitations, the arbitrator may award monetary damages and other remedies allowed by Governing Law. The arbitrator shall have no authority to modify any Agreement term or provision. The arbitrator shall deliver a reasoned, written decision to each party.

(vi) **Final and Binding Effect.** Any award shall be final and binding on the parties, deemed made at the arbitration seat, and each party shall promptly comply with the award.

(vii) **Enforcement.** Any award (including interim or final remedies) may be confirmed in or enforced by any court having jurisdiction over either party or its assets, including courts identified in the jurisdiction and venue provision in Regional Terms.

(b) **Dispute Notices.** Before commencing arbitration, the claiming party shall send a written dispute notice to the other. All dispute notices to Paystream shall be sent to notices@paystream.com. All dispute notices to User shall be sent to the email address on the applicable Account. All notices must (i) provide User's name, email, mailing address, and Paystream account ID (if any); (ii) describe the dispute's nature and factual and legal basis; and (iii) detail specific relief sought. If User appoints counsel to submit its notice, User shall provide written authorization allowing Paystream to discuss User's dispute and account details with User's counsel.
